records.description: Custom API dispatch, __tf_tensor__ unrestricted return branch, registered codecs, Sparse/IndexedSlices/Ragged/Composite/extension/resource protocols need full domains and validation/error semantics; retain all as obligations, not exclusions.

Generated wrappers, EagerTensor native scalar/array conversion, complete DType.as_dtype/parser/native tables, installed NumPy/ml_dtypes effects and exact error priorities remain outside this selected source closure.

The non-eager EagerTensor branch returns graph.capture(self, name=name) without forwarding dtype or invoking the superclass branch. Analyze graph.capture, same/foreign graph, device/cancellation/distributed context and eager/traced/function/export configurations before claiming identity/mismatch equivalence.

Only selected flexible policy cells are described. Full strong/weak n-ary order laws, string/object/resource/variant/quantized/custom/reduced dtype membership and actual op legality remain open; no NumPy/JAX/Torch table substitution. Ordered conversion/add rounding is modeled only for the selected finite mixed-add fixtures. Inexact casting, all modes, nonfinite/overflow, hardware rounding/subnormal behavior remain open public obligations. Signed-zero-sensitive/native exceptional-value fixtures remain unmaterialized; finite analytical guards do not exclude them from public parity.

The primary canonical TF inventory lacks records for the source-exported experimental NumPy result_type/promote_types/enable behavior names. Preserve their source obligations; this proposal does not classify/admit new names or close that denominator gap.

Native Tensor identity, eager copied ndarray snapshot, buffers/views and device movement differ. Native noncontiguous/zero extent/overlap lifetime plus every legal accelerator/backend target require exact observations; host staging has no target execution credit.

Forward/reverse/higher/batched/complex AD through all hooks, casts, weak results, resources, composites and compiled effects remains partial. Absence, integer nondifferentiability and user-requested zero cotangents are distinct. The selected protocol fixture rejects impossible finite outputs/cotangents; overflow/nonfinite/inexact cotangent and full AD/protocol behavior remain unrun obligations, never scope exclusions or inferred TensorFlow errors.

Input policy, variable storage/reads, actual compute/accumulation, optimizer/loss scaling, quantized policies and backend helpers are separate. Keras docs allow wider device-internal intermediates; workspace native-precision/associated-Accumulator design needs source-specific equivalence review, not an implicit precision waiver.

Frozen source pins are not resolved installed artifacts. TensorFlow wheel/build ABI/platform, NumPy/ml_dtypes/Keras exact compatible artifacts, device drivers/plugins/compiler/StableHLO and hardware receipts remain required after dependency resolution; no old-version workaround.

Independent source/semantic review and exact canonical join/schema/selector/no-credit tests are pending. Proposal stage stays unmapped for primary; actual implementation owner and architecture approval remain unresolved.
